runs.str: Find the matching pairs and correct answers will reveal a picture and music.
For each correct match you get 10 points added to your score.  For each
incorrect match 2 points are subtracted from your score. Correct answers
will reveal a picture and music.
When you are ready to play, choose a level and then click Start to begin
the Experimental Results vs. Mathematical Probability Match Game.
Click one box then find the next box that matches and click it.
